scientific_question: At the already-frozen 28 deterioration decision timestamps, do independently motivated funding-market or credit-market stress mechanisms distinguish the 4 destructive collapses from 24 temporary deteriorations better than the consumed equity/MTS information?

source.artifact: OFR Financial Stress Index full CSV
source.publication_lag: OFR states FSI publishes with data current from two business days prior
source.revision_warning: Current historical file is revision-capable, not a preserved real-time vintage. Any pass is hypothesis-generating and requires vintage/independent validation before operational use.

admitted_raw_series.mechanism: difficulty financial institutions have funding activities / counterparty-liquidity stress

direction: higher or more positive means greater stress; no sign search
decision_alignment: Use latest OFR observation that would have been published by the frozen decision close under the stated two-business-day publication lag; operational extraction therefore uses source observation t-2 business observations, never same-day revised value.
primary_tests: Each of six transformed variables is tested independently; no combinations, interactions, threshold optimization, GA, or portfolio action.

primary_gate.threshold_rule: minimum score among the 4 positives; count negatives at or above it

multiple_testing: Six prespecified independent diagnostics; a pass is hypothesis-generating only and does not establish an operational crash predictor.
sensitivity: same-day revised-value diagnostic reported separately but cannot override lagged primary
stop_rule: If neither Funding nor Credit produces a compelling independent pass, terminate OFR FSI mechanism family; do not add OFR FSI components post hoc. Cboe VIX/VVIX remains a separately preregistered mechanism family, not a rescue search.
